name: 22151 · Springfield, VA
findings: ZIP 22151 (Springfield) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22151 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22151 (Springfield) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
